BLOB_XMAX

Absolute Address:

Source:

Description

Maximum X coordinate (rightmost pixel column) of the bounding box for the blob selected by BLOB_ADDR. Valid when STATUS.FRAME_DONE = 1. Reading may auto-increment BLOB_ADDR when CTRL.BLOB_ADDR_AUTOINC = 1. Bits [31:16] are reserved.
